title: Assistant Professor - Economics
description:
Description

The School of Analytics, Finance, and Economics invites those with
potential for excellence in scholarly research and in teaching
Economics graduate courses in microeconomic theory as well as
undergraduate courses in Economics and Business Analytics to submit
an application for consideration as an Assistant Professor. This
position is a continuing, tenure track, 9-month appointment to
start August 10, 2027.

This position is represented by SIU Carbondale Faculty
Association/IEA-NEA. For more information regarding salary and
other details please visit: https://laborrelations.siu.edu/labor-contracts .




Salary is competitive and commensurate with qualifications and
experience, while also considering internal equity.

Examples of Duties

The selected candidate will teach graduate and undergraduate
courses on a 2/2 teaching load, engage in scholarly research, and
provide School/University service appropriate of academic rank.
Graduate-level teaching includes doctoral-level courses.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: PhD in Economics or a related
discipline. ABD applicants will be considered if all requirements
for the PhD degree will be completed by August 10, 2027. If all
requirements for the doctorate have not been completed by date of
appointment, a nine-month, term, non-tenure-track appointment at
the rank of Instructor may be offered in accordance with University
policy ( 
https://policies.siu.edu/personnel-policies/chapter2/ch2-faps/faculty-contingent.php
). Applicants must show strong potential to engage in research that
leads to publications in high quality journals and to effectively
teach doctoral courses in microeconomic theory.

Preferred Qualifications: Preference will be given to
candidates with high quality journal publications as well as those
who can teach graduate courses in Development, International, or
Monetary Economics and/or teach Law and Economics at the
undergraduate level. Preference will also be given to those who can
teach Business Analytics at the undergraduate level.

Required Documents : Submit a letter of application,
curriculum vita, transcripts,a job market paper, and three
references. Candidates who have experience working with a diverse
range of faculty, staff, and students and who can contribute to the
climate of inclusivity are encouraged to identify their experiences
in these areas in the letter.
Contact: Kevin Sylwester, ksylwest@siu.edu

Supplemental Information

College of Business and Analytics at Southern Illinois University
Carbondale (SIUC), is accredited by the Association to Advance
Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). We offer Bachelor of
Science undergraduate academic degree programs in our School of
Management and Marketing, School of Analytics, Finance and
Economics, and School of Accountancy. We offer graduate academic
degrees with master’s programs in Business Administration (MBA),
Public Administration (MPA), Business Analytics, Economics,
Accountancy (MACC), Business Analytics, and doctoral degree
programs in Business Administration and Economics. Please visit our
website at 
www.business.siu.edu .
